sequential_gate: P0R completion and independent validation before any survival fit; proceed regardless of its sign

endpoints.PFS: secondary: explicit PFS_MONTHS/PFS_STATUS, valid positive time and binary status; fixed-fold subset, no endpoint pooling

outer_cv: reuse committed patient-level five folds; seeds alter only inner split, not independent cohorts
inner_cv: one 80/20 stratified event-by-cancer-type split inside each outer-train; event-only fallback if sparse

representations.C: AGE, SEX, Stage, T, N, M only; train median age and train-only one-hot; same historical supplement fill
representations.R: RNA-linear: log2(x+1), train median, coverage >=90%, train variance Top512 before standardization
representations.U: frozen UNI2-h full-patch mean per slide then equal-slide patient mean; NOT ABMIL
representations.S: frozen 32 morphologic TITAN static concept cosine scores
representations.M: same fixed eight true RNA molecular state scores as Phase7-P0
representations.MC: eight RNA and eight signed CNA molecular scores, separate 16D evidence

head: one-stage joint ridge Cox, Efron ties, float64; standardized columns with no dimension rescaling; no stacked in-sample predictions or cross-fit latent coordinates
selection: inner held-out Harrell C; ties prefer larger ridge; all upstream data-adaptive transforms fit only inner-train
fit: L-BFGS, mean negative Efron partial log likelihood per event plus lambda/2 * squared coefficient norm; maxiter=5000, ftol=1e-13, gtol=1e-7; require max absolute gradient <=1e-5, identical selection/final schedule
risk_calibration: OOF risk centered and scaled only by corresponding model training risk mean/std; no test distribution or labels in calibration; report raw-risk sensitivity separately
metrics: primary full-horizon pooled OOF Harrell; secondary Uno IPCW at prelocked 60 months using each held-out patient's outer-train censoring KM, left limit and no clipping; also report within-fold pair-weighted C and Uno
ties: Harrell comparable event-before-later-patient or event/censor at same time; tied observed events excluded; reverse censoring KM removes observed events first at tied times; explicitly left-limit IPCW version
bootstrap: 2000 paired patient multiplicity resamples stratified by event and fixed fold, same resamples for all methods and seeds; conditional on fitted OOF, no model retraining
decision: DSS robust positive increment requires Bonferroni family interval lower bound >0 for primary Harrell, positive mean Uno and positive Harrell in all three split seeds; otherwise report evidence insufficient, not absence of information; PFS separate exploratory secondary family
scope: frozen representations and common linear convex head; not an upper bound on every nonlinear/MIL head, not an independent external cohort
data_repair: none; preserve P0 pathways, concept vocabulary and source matrices; no outcome-based feature selection
publication: code, protocols, aggregate convergence/metrics/comparisons/decisions only; OOF, patient data, weights and raw H5 stay server-private
